description: Not sure yet? Build a strong foundation and discover what excites you most.

phases.title: Phase 1: Foundations (Weeks 1–4)
items: Networking Basics — IP, HTTP, DNS (TryHackMe: Pre-Security)
How the Web Works — PortSwigger Web Security Academy (Intro)
Cyber Security Basics — CIA Triad, common attacks, terminology

phases.title: Phase 2: Explore Paths (Weeks 5–8)
items: Try Web Security — PortSwigger Labs (XSS, SQLi basics)
Try Networking — Wireshark packet capture on your own traffic
Try Cloud — Launch a free AWS/Azure VM and secure it
Try Scripting — Automate a small task in Python

phases.title: Phase 3: Choose Your Direction (Weeks 9–12)
items: Pick the path that felt most exciting — go deeper
Build 1 project in that path — documented on GitHub
Join a community — Discord, Reddit r/cybersecurity, local meetups
Start applying for internships or entry-level roles
